# LRF-IMU-HARTH agent guide

## PURPOSE

This repository is the model-only HARTH-family LRF-IMU pipeline. It covers
raw-data validation, subject-safe preprocessing, training-only normalisation,
VAE training, ten-class latent Rectified Flow training, evaluation, and
fixed-window signal generation.

Downstream contextual mapping, interval eligibility, cohort orchestration,
long-interval stitching, and multimodal linkage are out of scope. Do not add
application-specific data models or policies to the core package.

## PRODUCTION CONTRACT

- Data composition: `harth_walking_speed`
- Data commit: `dad2cfbe89a26f72f19770419469ac037de200df`
- Training code commit: `81b123eab079f5cde7400fee5620e3bffb85a673`
- Held-out subject: `harth:S006`
- Seed: 42
- Sampling frequency: 50 Hz
- Input geometry: three channels, 160 samples, 40-sample hop
- VAE latent geometry: `[48, 40]`
- Flow classes: 10
- Observed production Flow width: 256

One global checkpoint pair was reused by every downstream cohort. There are
no persona-specific checkpoint files.

## PRODUCTION ARTIFACTS

- `vae_s3_z48.pt`:
  `6B118182E14FF04CBD57D66A76986BF3568561F0FD42D02257F8036A0138AAD9`
- `flow_unet_best.pt`:
  `F1058EB1FB94809B74B8DFFC24E2697F8C73B046CF2A8E7D24FFF60EC6D63164`
- `normalization_harth_s006.json`:
  `F8F5E51085211BE731895744CB002815158CB5E59172E8D0BF7064A77274295B`
- Manifest:
  `src/lrf_imu/resources/manifests/production_harth_v1.json`

Never substitute similarly named files. Verify size and SHA-256 before load.
Large binaries and raw data are GitHub Release assets, never normal Git blobs.

## IMPORTANT PATHS

- `src/lrf_imu/data/`: source adapters, taxonomy, splits, windows, normalisation
- `src/lrf_imu/models/`: VAE and Flow architectures
- `src/lrf_imu/training/`: frozen training and HARTH orchestration
- `src/lrf_imu/generation/`: reverse-Euler latent sampling
- `src/lrf_imu/evaluation/`: model sanity/evaluation
- `src/lrf_imu/artifacts.py`: release-asset acquisition and verification
- `configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml`: production model contract

## TAXONOMY

IDs are fixed: 0 `walking_slow`, 1 `walking_moderate`, 2 `walking_brisk`,
3 `running`, 4 `stair_climbing`, 5 `cycling_seated`, 6 `cycling_standing`,
7 `sitting`, 8 `standing`, 9 `lying`.

## COMMANDS

```text
python -m lrf_imu fetch-production-artifacts --output-dir <artifacts>
python -m lrf_imu verify-production-artifacts --artifact-dir <artifacts>
python -m lrf_imu prepare-harth-data --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --window-length 160 --hop-length 40 --seed 42
python -m lrf_imu train-harth-vae --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --output-dir <vae-output> --seed 42
python -m lrf_imu train-harth-flow --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --vae-checkpoint <vae> --output-dir <flow-output> --seed 42
python -m lrf_imu evaluate-harth-vae --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --vae-checkpoint <vae> --output-dir <output>
python -m lrf_imu evaluate-harth-flow --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --vae-checkpoint <vae> --flow-checkpoint <flow> --output-dir <output>
python -m lrf_imu generate-harth --flow-checkpoint <flow> --vae-checkpoint <vae> --activity sitting --seed 42 --device cuda
```

## TESTS

```text
python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q
python scripts/check_syntax.py
python -m ruff check src/lrf_imu/artifacts.py src/lrf_imu/cli.py scripts/check_syntax.py tests/test_core_release_boundary.py tests/test_production_artifacts.py
git diff --check
```

## GUARDRAILS

- Do not change the ten-class taxonomy or accepted checkpoint identities.
- Do not pair the 3-channel HARTH checkpoints with 6-channel REALDISP models.
- Do not fit normalisation on validation or held-out subjects.
- Do not silently change the fixed 300-epoch Flow schedule.
- Do not commit raw data, checkpoints, generated arrays, or cohort outputs.
- Do not introduce participant/persona or application-specific mapping logic.
- Preserve the source repository history; cleanup belongs on a new branch/tag.
